questions.scenario: Imagine you are in a park with your friend. You both hear the sound of a bird singing from different distances.
questions.question: Explain why the sound of the bird seems louder when you are close to it.
marking_criteria: Explanation of how distance affects sound loudness.
Mention of sound getting quieter as you move away.
hints: Think about how sound travels from the bird to your ears.

model_answer.working: Sound travels from the bird to our ears. When we are close to the bird, the sound waves reach us more directly and with more energy, making the sound seem louder. As we move away, the sound waves spread out and lose energy, making the sound seem quieter.
model_answer.result: The sound seems louder when you are close to the bird because the sound waves reach your ears with more energy.

questions.explanation: Consider how sound travels and how it behaves when it moves from the source to your ears.

questions.scenario: Imagine you are in a park with your friend. You both hear the sound of a bird singing from different distances.
questions.question: Describe how the sound of the bird changes as you walk away from it.
marking_criteria: Description of how the sound becomes quieter.
Mention of distance affecting how we hear the sound.
hints: Think about what happens to the sound as you move further from the bird.

model_answer.working: As you walk away from the bird, the sound waves spread out more and lose energy. This makes the sound seem quieter because there are fewer sound waves reaching your ears.
model_answer.result: The sound of the bird becomes quieter as you walk away from it.

questions.explanation: Consider how the distance from the sound source affects the loudness of the sound you hear.

questions.scenario: Imagine you are in a park with your friend. You both hear the sound of a bird singing from different distances.
questions.question: State one way you can tell if a sound is loud or quiet.
marking_criteria: Identification of a method to determine loudness.
hints: Think about how you can physically sense the difference in loudness.

model_answer.working: You can tell if a sound is loud or quiet by how it affects your ears. A loud sound might make your ears hurt or feel pressure, while a quiet sound might be harder to hear.
model_answer.result: One way to tell if a sound is loud or quiet is by how it affects your ears.

questions.explanation: Consider the physical sensations that help you determine the loudness of a sound.
